author: DistroTube
description:
RefreshOS 3 brings together the stability of Debian 13 and the beauty of KDE Plasma 6 into a desktop experience that simply feels right. Built with Qt 6 and the Linux 6.12 kernel, it delivers a modern desktop that feels fast, clean, smooth, and genuinely enjoyable to use every day.
